service_signature_method.multiset: Restart FNV offset for each accepted request, sum request hashes modulo2**64. Not a cryptographic proof; exact-byte goldens and per-line occurrence assertions remain mandatory.
service_signature_method.ordered_write: Continuous FNV over write tuples only. Data lines32..used-16 ascending, then descriptor0,16.
service_signature_method.request_tuple: direction,address,assumed_response_latency, followed only for writes by four zero-extended32bit payload words in ascending byte order
service_signature_method.word_encoding: Every word eight bytes little endian; all operations modulo 2**64. Directions write1/read0; address is byte address.

integrated_rtl.tile_bank_ownership: At most two occupied tile banks; an emitting bank is distinct from a preparing bank; a prepared tile cannot be reused until its 64th scalar is accepted; an accepted external read remains physically owned through abort, reset, replacement start, matching error, and stale response drain; final done follows final dense acceptance, all bank releases and pending-read drain.

timestamp_contract.bounded_read_ownership: One immutable offered/accepted needed-line read at a time, filling an existing segment cache only after matching successful ACK. No added payload cache. Current tile/raw scalar remains immutable during output hold. Offered or accepted prefetch drains before demand reader continues. Full next-tile merging remains unimplemented.
timestamp_contract.bounded_tile_ownership: Two64x16bit coefficient banks and independent validity masks; preparing bank distinct from immutable emitting bank. Completed bank remains occupied until64th accepted scalar. Producer starts onlynextsequentialblock in a free bank; accepted external memory request remains a separate hazard. RAW retains previous qualified schedule.
timestamp_contract.bounded_write_ownership: One immutable offered/accepted16B slot and one16B assembler, plus existing scalar pending record. At most1accepted physical request; seal waits for physical ACK drainage; header writes retain sequential ACK gating.
timestamp_contract.clock: Single simulated decoder clock; no achieved target frequency or physical controller calibration
timestamp_contract.current_endpoint: One BR88 residual chunk through packed scratch and dense coefficient completion
timestamp_contract.edge_convention: Start edge excluded. Subsequent running rising edges are numbered from1. Histograms sample the pre-edge FSM state. Timestamps identify the accepting/observing edge, not wall-clock milliseconds.
timestamp_contract.emitter_partition: The latched store mode determines this independent histogram; pre-allocation history may still be legacy. Sum(emitter_state_cycles)=cycles. Do not add to packet/scratch histograms.

timestamp_contract.interpretation: The packet and scratch histograms each partition the same active interval; do not add them together. Stall/event counters overlap those partitions. State occupancy is not a causal promise that all its cycles can be removed. A memory service hash matches ordered requests, write payloads and assumed ACK delay, excluding epoch tags and absolute cycle. In two-bank coded mode, the scratch histogram is the preparation FSM and output delivery is independent. Its EMIT occupancy is not dense delivery. Tile masks/bank storage are logical RTL; no achieved mapping or routed timing is claimed.

scope: Independent V88 packet decode and packed-image reconstruction for the frozen 20-case V91e fixture; verifies V91g2 source/artifact/tool pins, dense simulation assertions and telemetry, two-bank tile preparation/emission ownership, fixture-derived canonical read/write service signatures, once-per-line traffic coverage, exact nine-metric and ordered-service V91g tile-overlap-off parity at seeds 910432/910433, and exact RAW-path parity in both tile modes. The abstract bank model is bounded event evidence, not an RTL or timing proof. Coefficient endpoint only; no full-frame publication, hardware or fps claim.

limits: Three abstract scalars per tile and two abstract preparation steps; not a cycle or RTL equivalence model.
Unaccepted request-offer backpressure and cancellation are covered by directed RTL hazards, not this event model.
